text:
GET /rsv/v1/hotels/{hotelId}/roomCalendar
Operation: getRoomCalendar
Summary: Get the room calendar
Description: Use this API to get the room calendar for your Hotel.   OperationId: getRoomCalendar   This API allows a time span of  366  days.
Tags: Reservation
Parameters:
  - hotelId (path, string, required): Unique ID of the hotel where reservation is searched based on reservation ID.
  - advanceCheckedIn (query, boolean, optional): If true, then filter room results to rooms with Advance Checked In Reservations.
  - assignedRooms (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to rooms that are assigned to guest.
  - componentRooms (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to component rooms.
  - connectingRoomsOnly (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to only connecting rooms.
  - backToBackOnly (query, boolean, optional): Indicates that only reservations marked as Back to Back should be expected in the result.
  - linkedReservationsOnly (query, boolean, optional): Indicates that only linked reservations are expected in the result.
  - linkedName (query, string, optional): Name of the group of Linked Reservations to be searched.
  - scheduledRoomMoveOnly (query, boolean, optional): Indicates that only reservations having scheduled room moves should be expected in the result.
  - dueOut (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to rooms with Due Out Reservations.
  - endDate (query, string, optional): The ending value of the date range.
  - isSortDescending (query, boolean, optional): If true, then fetch result will be sorted in descending order.
  - pageIndex (query, integer, optional): Page index to be retrieved.
  - partiallyAssignedRooms (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to component rooms that have at least one of its rooms assigned to guest.
  - recordsPerPage (query, integer, optional): Number of records per page.
  - roomConditions (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to rooms with Room Conditions.
  - ownerRoomsOnly (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to rooms with rotation rooms only. It is supported only if OPERA Control Room Rotation is active.
  - ownerExclusiveOnly (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to rooms that are exclusive to the owner. It is supported only if OPERA Control Room Rotation is active.
  - sortingBy (query, string, optional): A collection of supported sorting for room calendar.
  - includeRoomMoveHistory (query, boolean, optional): Include Room Move History in result.
  - includeComponentRoomBlockOutDates (query, boolean, optional): Include information about Component Room Reservation dates when fetching a component suite.
  - startDate (query, string, optional): The starting value of the date range.
  - unassignedRooms (query, string, optional): If 'Y', then filter room results to rooms that are not yet assigned to guest.
  - roomId (query, array, optional): Room search filter.
  - roomType (query, array, optional): Room Type search filter.
  - roomClass (query, array, optional): Room Class search filter.
  - floor (query, array, optional): Floor search filter.
  - roomFeature (query, array, optional): A code representing a room feature.
  - roomStatus (query, array, optional): Simple type for room status instructions to be used in requests for fetching housekeeping rooms. Valid status values are Clean, Dirty, Pickup, Inspected, OutOfOrder, OutOfService.
  - smokingPreference (query, array, optional): Smoking Preference filter.
  - bedType (query, array, optional): 
  - showRoomMoveSegments (query, boolean, optional): If set to true then reservations having past or future room moves will come according to the exact stay dates in the rooms.
  - x-externalsystem (header, string, optional): External system code.
Response Schema: {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "roomCalendar": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "room": "...",
        "hotelId": "...",
        "totalRooms": "...",
        "pageIndex": "...",
        "recordsPerPage": "..."
      }
    },
    "links": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": "..."
    },
    "warnings": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": "..."
    }
  }
}
Error Codes: 400, 401, 403, 404, 405, 406, 413, 414, 415, 500, 502, 503

  - state (query, string, optional): State or Province name (e.g., Texas).
  - code (query, string, optional): Code for a country or a nationality.

description:
API that manages requests for Door Lock Room Keys. This operation is used by OPERA Cloud PMS connected to external Door Lock Systems systems via Outbound Systems configuration: 

 OPERA Cloud utilizes this operation  

- to request new or additional room keys - e.g. when guest checks in, or additional keys post check in.

- to request to activate new keys after check on e.g. when a room key has been lost for a room.

- to request a room key which is not related to a guest reservation but valid for a defined time - (for show rooms, repair) - One Shot Key.

- to request to re-encode a key whereby other keys for this room remain active.

- to request to read a key data from a room key and display it to the user in the PMS.

- to request to modify existing key data - upon room move or change of departure date. (online key systems only!!)

- to request to remove / delete a room key from a room on. Usually sent with check out of a reservation.

Use this API to post a room key action to the active Door Lock System.

 Notes on keyType values: 

 keyType = New

keyType = Lost  

It is expected that all previous active keys for the room will become invalid.

It is expected that partner system handles multiple keys being active in case numberOfKeys is >1.

 keyType = Duplicate

keyType = ReEncode 

It is expected that existing active keys for this room remain active.

 keyType = OneShot 

It is expected that the room key is only valid for a room for specific time (for maintenance or Show room).

It is never related to a reservation.

 keyType = Read  A request to the Key Card system to read Key Card information from requested Key Encoder/reader.

The Key Read functionality is of pure informational purpose. None of the received information is stored or processed in the PMS, and it is only for display to the user.

 keyType = Remove 

It is expected that with this request all active keys for a room or reservation will become inactive or invalid so they will not be able to open the room after defined validityEnd time.

 Additional KeyType actions used by Online Door Lock Systems: 

 Online Key card Systems  are systems which do not write guest data to the room key directly but do store guest data internally and send the information to the related door lock.

 keyType = ModifyStay 

For Online Door Lock Systems - Request to adjust Room key data when guest changes length of stay (validityEnd)

 keyType = RoomMove 

For Online Door Lock Systems - adjust Room key data when guest performs room move. 

  OperationId:  postExternalRoomKeys

description:
API that manages requests for Door Lock Room Keys. This operation is used by OPERA Cloud PMS connected to external Door Lock Systems systems via Outbound Systems configuration: 

 OPERA Cloud utilizes this operation  

- to request new or additional room keys - e.g. when guest checks in, or additional keys post check in.

- to request to activate new keys after check on e.g. when a room key has been lost for a room.

- to request a room key which is not related to a guest reservation but valid for a defined time - (for show rooms, repair) - One Shot Key.

- to request to re-encode a key whereby other keys for this room remain active.

- to request to read a key data from a room key and display it to the user in the PMS.

- to request to modify existing key data - upon room move or change of departure date. (online key systems only!!)

- to request to remove / delete a room key from a room on. Usually sent with check out of a reservation.

Use this API to post a room key action to the active Door Lock System.

 Notes on keyType values: 

 keyType = New

keyType = Lost  

It is expected that all previous active keys for the room will become invalid.

It is expected that partner system handles multiple keys being active in case numberOfKeys is >1.

 keyType = Duplicate

keyType = ReEncode 

It is expected that existing active keys for this room remain active.

 keyType = OneShot 

It is expected that the room key is only valid for a room for specific time (for maintenance or Show room).

It is never related to a reservation.

 keyType = Read  A request to the Key Card system to read Key Card information from requested Key Encoder/reader.

The Key Read functionality is of pure informational purpose. None of the received information is stored or processed in the PMS, and it is only for display to the user.

 keyType = Remove 

It is expected that with this request all active keys for a room or reservation will become inactive or invalid so they will not be able to open the room after defined validityEnd time.

 Additional KeyType actions used by Online Door Lock Systems: 

 Online Key card Systems  are systems which do not write guest data to the room key directly but do store guest data internally and send the information to the related door lock.

 keyType = ModifyStay 

For Online Door Lock Systems - Request to adjust Room key data when guest changes length of stay (validityEnd)

 keyType = RoomMove 

For Online Door Lock Systems - adjust Room key data when guest performs room move. 

  OperationId:  postRoomKeysExternal
